answer_1.quote: Our goal is to generate keyphrases that are likely to be words absent from the document... Thus, we formulate our problem as keyphrase generation (KG) of predicting keyphrases, including absent words as well as present words, adopting encoder-decoder architecture.

answer_2.quote: As in , we adopted macroaveraged F1@k and mean average precision (mAP) as evaluation metrics... We report F1@1/3 for Twitter/Weibo and F1@3/5 for StackExchange... For all datasets, we report mAP over the top-5 predictions.
